source.label: FY2025 Form 10-K, Item 1 Our People
source.quote: As of December 31, 2025, we employed approximately 39,800 persons globally, of which approximately 70% were employed outside of the U.S. in more than 90 countries.

source.label: FY2025 Form 10-K, MD&A, general and administrative expenses table ($ in millions)

notes: Employees: approximate year-end count from the FY2025 10-K; the 10-K says the employee base is predominantly full-time and that Mastercard also had about 6,000 contingent workers, who are not counted. Payroll: the Personnel line of general and administrative expenses in the MD&A. The 10-K's human-capital section separately states "The total cost of our workforce for the year ended December 31, 2025 was $7.3 billion, which primarily consists of compensation, benefits and other personnel-related costs." The 2026 proxy reports a 2025 median employee annual total compensation of $124,650 (CEO pay ratio 284 to 1), not used because a total is disclosed.
